name: How should I prepare for a foreclosed bathroom refresh consultation?

mainEntity.name: How should I prepare for a foreclosed bathroom refresh consultation?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before bringing in a contractor, check if the utilities are active and inspect the space for major moisture issues. Document existing conditions with photos and test whether water and electrical services are turned on, as un-winterized foreclosures often have drained lines or shut-off power. Identify any visible water stains, damaged subflooring, or abandoned plumbing fixtures. Knowing whether you plan to hold the property as a rental or flip it helps establish material priorities. Having this baseline information ready allows your contractor to assess plumbing, electrical, and finish carpentry needs accurately during the initial walk-through.
acceptedAnswer.description: Verify that utilities are connected, photograph existing damage, and identify key budget priorities before your contractor inspects the home.
